decisions.text: The reading room can also be used for meetings if it is empty (not reserved, no one reading)
The reading room will be a two-person room
The middle two-person room is chosen as the reading room
The photocopier and the network printer will go next to the mailbox

deadlines.text: Administration wants the office and equipment placement by November 2nd (next Tuesday)
